# Scenario: full registry credentials + failed docker login → docker_login_failed;
# compose may be written, but pull/up stop. Prune is skipped. (Nginx is skipped only
# when apinfra-proxy is not already running on the Docker host.)
#
# Project name is unique so leftover host containers from other scenarios
# (e.g. apinfra_e2e-web-web-1) do not false-positive the "! running" assert.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: app needing compose up'
cd ..

# Unreachable registry so docker login fails quickly (short timeout).
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'logging into registry 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'docker login 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'pruning skipped'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'docker_login_failed' $HOME/.events
grep '127.0.0.1:1' $HOME/.events

# Compose may already be on disk; this cycle must not have started the app.
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-dlogin/docker-compose.yml
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-dlogin-web

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=bad
containerRegistryToken=bad
dockerLoginTimeout=5s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-dlogin
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-dlogin/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
